test_bedrock_token_counting: test the BedrockTokenCounter class to count tokens for Amazon Nova models on AWS Bedrock
test_bedrock_count_tokens_endpoint_defau: test the default Bedrock count tokens endpoint URL construction for a given model and region
test_bedrock_count_tokens_api_base_overr: test that a custom api_base parameter overrides the default Bedrock count tokens endpoint URL
test_bedrock_count_tokens_runtime_endpoi: test that aws_bedrock_runtime_endpoint overrides the default Bedrock count tokens endpoint URL
test_bedrock_count_tokens_endpoint_prior: test that api_base takes priority over aws_bedrock_runtime_endpoint when both are provided
